newsitem.title: FRANCE: France govt confirms plan to cap 98 state spending.
newsitem.headline: France govt confirms plan to cap 98 state spending.

text.p: Prime Minister Alain Juppe's office confirmed on Thursday that ministries were being asked to cap French 1998 state spending at the level foreseen in the 1997 budget.

Government sources had already said this week that the plan was to keep state spending capped for a second year running in 1998 and that this would in fact mean cuts to account for the spending rise that would otherwise have been made due to inflation.
The confirmation on Thursday came in a copy of the letter which Juppe has sent to ministries.
